title: ADR-026: Super Admin Platform Dashboard — Cross-Tenant Control Tower
description: Implement the Super Admin Platform Dashboard for cross-tenant monitoring: business overview (maturity stage, sales counts), WhatsApp bridge status, and AI usage billing telemetry. Platform/Core domain per ADR-025 §3.1. No new tables — uses existing businesses, whatsapp_sessions, ai_usage, readiness_snapshots, sales_events. Auth guard requirePlatformOwner() with fail-closed PLATFORM_OWNER_ID env check. Three API endpoints via createAdminClient(). Frontend with Quiet Chrome aesthetic (Slate dark, glassmorphism, indigo accents). Security tests verifying 403 for unauthorized users.

classification.rationale: Classified as COMPLEX. Primary domain: platform. New cross-tenant API surface with security implications (PLATFORM_OWNER_ID guard, admin client bypassing RLS). 8+ new files. No schema changes (existing tables). No AI behavior changes. Security is the critical concern — unauthorized access exposes all tenant data.

decisions.rationale: ADR-026 is well-scoped within Platform/Core domain (ADR-025 §3.1). No new tables needed — leverages existing schema. Auth guard pattern mirrors requireDeliveryAdmin(). Quiet Chrome aesthetic is consistent. 3 endpoints are focused and well-defined.

All 3 endpoints follow existing patterns: requirePageAuth + inline owner check + createAdminClient for cross-tenant reads. Column names corrected (tokens_input/output, not prompt/completion). whatsapp_sessions creds column never selected. Error handling via handleApiError.

Server Component → Client Component pattern matches analytics/page.tsx. shadcn Card/Badge available. No table.tsx in shadcn — using styled HTML table matching ADR vision. Glassmorphism Quiet Chrome aesthetic. Components under 150 lines. Accessible and responsive.

PLATFORM_OWNER_ID env-based identity with fail-closed guard. ApiForbiddenError for clean 403. whatsapp_sessions creds never selected. createAdminClient bypasses RLS by design but guarded by requirePlatformOwner(). No raw messages or customer data exposed — only aggregated metrics. Defense in depth: proxy + route-level guard.

Cross-tenant queries are aggregation-only (SUM, COUNT). ai_usage has indexes on business_id and created_at. readiness_snapshots ordered by calculated_at DESC — may need index review at scale but acceptable for v1 with few tenants. No real-time push needed — polling sufficient. No premature optimization.

Full quality gate suite: lint, build, unit_tests, e2e_tests, chrome_devtools, security_review, stress_test. Security tests verifying 403 for unauthorized users and 200 for authorized. Cost calculation unit tests. maturity_stage nullable handling tests.

Will stress-test: (1) PLATFORM_OWNER_ID env spoofing, (2) cross-tenant data leakage via api routes, (3) whatsapp_sessions creds column access attempts, (4) race conditions on concurrent admin queries, (5) malformed env vars (undefined PLATFORM_OWNER_ID), (6) unauthorized user hitting /dashboard/platform-admin page directly.

Atomic commits per step. ADR-026 document committed first. Conventional commit format. PLATFORM_OWNER_ID must be added to .env.local manually (not committed). Push to main, Vercel deploy with verification.
